medium_negotiation.recovery_note: Complete both times, four moves: yield instantly (no relitigating, no second offer), ratify the choice as sensible, de-personalise the refusal, re-anchor rapport and pivot. The ACCOUNT is a slot with two attested types — capacity ('not feeling up to it'), scoped to today, an implicit licence to re-offer next time; and stakes ('with something medical'), scoped to a domain, an implicit licence to keep the medium outside that domain. The offence-disclaimer tail is cultural form (Wales's politics of declining Welsh in a Welsh institution); the de-personalising function is canonical and survives in Bologna as the account itself plus warm ratification.
